originalParagraphs: QB-0078 - Jesus as “Spirit From God”
Comparison evidence: NT Spirit/Christology texts
Classification: UNUSUAL TERMINOLOGICAL PARALLEL / THEOLOGICAL DIFFERENCE
Assessment: Quranic “Spirit from Him” is elevated but cannot simply be equated with Jesus being the Holy Spirit or a divine Spirit-person.
Checkpoint 007 Continuation - QB-0079 through QB-0092

QB-0109 — Serpent Versus Satan — Quran narrates Satan, not serpent; Genesis narrates serpent; later Revelation identifies ancient serpent with Devil/Satan. Narrative difference with later theological convergence.
QB-0110 — Adam’s Sin and Descendants — Quran states no inherited guilt; Romans 5 / 1 Corinthians 15 give Adam corporate significance. Major anthropological/soteriological difference.
QB-0115 — Noah’s Flood and Ark — strong narrative parallel with Quranic abbreviation.
QB-0116 — Hūd and ʿĀd — no canonical Bible narrative; source-history question.
QB-0117 — Ṣāliḥ and Thamūd — no canonical Bible narrative; historical/source-history question.
QB-0120 — Shuʿayb/Midian/Jethro-Reuel — Quran does not identify Shuʿayb as Moses’ father-in-law; later identification requires source-layer control.
QB-0122 — Release of Children of Israel — Quran / Exodus: strong direct parallel.
QB-0123 — Staff and Hand Signs — Quran / Exodus 4,7: strong parallel with performer/detail differences.
QB-0124 — Moses Versus Pharaoh’s Magicians — strong parallel; Exodus assigns staff action to Aaron where Quran emphasizes Moses.
QB-0125 — Conversion of Magicians — significant difference; Quran has conversion/prostration, Exodus does not.
QB-0126 — Killing Israelite Sons — thematic Exodus parallel with chronological/narrative differences.
QB-0127 — Egyptian Plagues — strong parallel but different selection/numbering.
QB-0128 — Prayer for Plague Removal — strong Exodus 8-10 parallel.
QB-0129 — Sea Destruction — strong Exodus 14 parallel.
QB-0131 — Exodus Deliverance as Basis for Exclusive Worship — strong parallel with Exodus 20 / Deuteronomy 5.
QB-0132 — Moses’ Forty Nights — strong parallel; Quran uniquely gives 30+10.
QB-0133 — Moses Requests to See God — strong Exodus 33 parallel with differing manifestation details; preserve internal Hebrew Bible seeing-God tensions.
QB-0134 — Moses Receives Divine Tablets — strong Torah parallel.
QB-0135 — Golden Calf — strong Exodus 32 parallel.
QB-0136 — Aaron’s Role in Golden Calf — significant narrative difference: Exodus makes Aaron active maker; Quran 7 presents him as resisting/overpowered.
QB-0137 — Moses and the Seventy — strong traditional parallel with Exodus 24 / Numbers 11 but different event details.
QB-0140 — Manna and Quail — strong Exodus 16 / Numbers 11 parallel.

QB-0143 — Quranic Injīl and Canonical Gospels — Quran presents Injīl as revelation given to Jesus; canonical Gospels present written proclamation/narrative about Jesus, not a book revealed to him. Significant conceptual difference.
